newsitem.title: FRANCE: Carrefour stock falls on weak Sept sales.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour stock falls on weak Sept sales.

text.p: Shares in retailer Carrefour fell on the Paris bourse on Thursday on disappointment with the group's weak 0.2 percent sales rise in September, traders said.

Carrefour said the sales results, including a 4.4 percent fall in French sales, reflected the fact that there was one less Saturday last month than in September 1995 and continued weak European consumer spending.

Its stock was down 1.26 percent at 2,893 francs at 1200 GMT, while the CAC-40 index was down 0.5 percent. Shares in retailer Promodes were 0.58 percent higher, suggesting some arbitrage between the two retail stocks, brokers said.
Carrefour reported nine-month sales were up 5.7 percent, compared with an 8.3 percent rise for the year-earlier period.
